answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 7526 Country: United Kingdom Title: Is it permissible to pray umorkaza salat between assr & maghrib. Question: assalamualikum respected mufti. sahib. Is it permissible to pray umorkaza salat between assr & maghrib. jazakumullahi khair Answer ID: 7526 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 929/933=M/1429) Yes, it is allowed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
